    Description
    ExperimentContent
    What one experiment toggle adds to a version's vanilla content, as BDS showed it: the bundled data of a version is captured without experiments, so this content is either missing from it (new items) or present but not usable without the toggle (blocks in the palette, items in the registry that only the toggle turns on).
    PaletteDataCodec
    The bundled data format: one gzipped big endian NBT compound per version.
    PropertyStore
    Every property of every item and block, stored once with the versions it is valid for.
    PropertyStore.Builder
    Collects property values per version.
    PropertyStore.Owner
    Whose property it is.
    Renames
    Identifiers Bedrock renamed, old to new, so content of an older version can be mapped forward to the newest one.
    Renames.Split
    A legacy item variant that became a type of its own.
    VanillaData
    All vanilla Bedrock data for one DataVersion.
    VanillaItem
    A vanilla item entry, as sent in the item registry by BDS.
    VersionFallbacks
    Replacements for blocks and items of the newest bundled version, for an older version that lacks them.
